caseStudies.title: Boardroom meeting experience modernization
caseStudies.challenge: The organization needed a reliable meeting room where executives could start calls quickly, present content easily, and communicate clearly with remote participants.
caseStudies.solution: GPSPL proposed a unified collaboration setup with commercial display, professional camera, room audio, microphones, wireless presentation, table connectivity and simplified control.
caseStudies.implementation: The room was installed, configured, tested across calling and presentation scenarios, documented, and handed over with user training.
caseStudies.results: The meeting experience became easier to operate, audio/video quality improved, and support dependency reduced through better standardization.

caseStudies.title: Hybrid learning and training environment
caseStudies.challenge: The client required a classroom and training setup that could support in-room teaching, remote participation, recording readiness and interactive content.
caseStudies.solution: GPSPL designed a hybrid collaboration environment with interactive display, camera, audio pickup, content sharing and teacher-friendly workflows.
caseStudies.implementation: The system was supplied, installed, commissioned and handed over with basic operating guidance for trainers and faculty.
caseStudies.results: Training sessions became more flexible, participants could join from remote locations, and the room remained easier to support.

faqs.question: What is Unified Communication & Collaboration?
faqs.answer: Unified Communication & Collaboration combines video conferencing, meeting-room audio, cameras, displays, presentation sharing, room control and IT readiness into one reliable communication environment.

faqs.question: Does GPSPL only install video conferencing equipment?
faqs.answer: No. GPSPL supports product supply, solution design, integration, commissioning, training, warranty coordination, AMC and after-sales support for complete collaboration environments.

faqs.question: Which spaces can GPSPL design for collaboration?
faqs.answer: GPSPL can support boardrooms, conference rooms, huddle rooms, training centers, smart classrooms, hybrid learning spaces, healthcare communication rooms, government facilities and enterprise campuses.

faqs.question: Which brands does GPSPL work with for UC solutions?
faqs.answer: GPSPL works with enterprise technology portfolios including HP Poly, Sony, Samsung, MAXHUB, Newline, BenQ, Harman Professional, JBL Professional, Crestron, AMX, ATEN, Lumens, LG Business Solutions and other project-fit technologies.

faqs.question: Can GPSPL help with product selection before purchase?
faqs.answer: Yes. GPSPL can help evaluate room size, participants, camera coverage, microphone pickup, display size, connectivity, platform requirements, budget and future support needs before preparing a solution.

faqs.question: Do you support Pan-India project execution?
faqs.answer: Yes. GPSPL can help standardize room types, product stacks, deployment methods and support planning for organizations with multiple branches, campuses or offices.

faqs.question: Do you provide AMC for meeting-room systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. GPSPL can provide AMC, preventive maintenance, technical troubleshooting, warranty guidance, support visits and upgrade planning based on project scope.

faqs.question: Can existing meeting rooms be upgraded?
faqs.answer: Yes. GPSPL can assess existing displays, cameras, microphones, cabling, network readiness and room usage to recommend practical upgrades where technically feasible.
